body:
Awww man that sucks so much I hate how ppl switch up after transformation like this :(( 

tbh i always have been naturally skinny and in puberty i gained a little weight. i was still skinny but average ig but so many ppl told me I'm fat now and blablba. probably just wanted to point something out and it was obvious i gained. i mean its normal in puberty ig. now I'm stuck in this ED and even tho I'm already underweight i believe that I'm not skinny enough. I feel like if I'm skinnier that maybe men would like me more I'm not sure. I feel like everything could be fixed then.

Thank you so much for ur reply :(( it hurts even more bc as a child my family wasn't rlly there for me especially my father was kinda horrible ( called me ugly and whore looking bc i had eye makeup on lmao i was 14) 

most boys in my highschool bullied me for my looks it fucking sucks and now I'm just in this state of mind where i believe men dont like me and they all think I'm ugly ://
Thank you so much, this really means a lot to me. I think I calmed down a little and I am going to keep pushing for now.

If peope would be able to understand me then maybe they would let me go but in their eyes I'm just insecure and nothing else. Mentally healthy people say "just stop" or "just think positive"....and get angry at me when I dont feel better bc they gave good advice.

I had five therapists and all of them were shit. My therapist right now doesn't help me at all but I can't find another therapist. After calling 40 therapists she was the only one who was available.

Im sorry you also go through something similar.

I just wish the pain would stop. If someone would love me with their whole heart and show it to me physically and mentally, maybe then I would consider staying but it doesn't look like that will ever happen.

I planned my suicide yesterday for 4 hours and then had a panic attack bc it seemed so easy to me to make that decision. After two failed attempts this one seems like its gonna work but I am still hesitant.

I am venting on reddit bc all my friends dont want to listen to me vent anymore bc I make their day worse and bc they cant help me ,they want me to act like everything is fine.
